title: Explore resolution helpers
instructions:
Implement pure Explore-resolution helpers in game-core/src/engine/explore.ts (NO RNG, NO state mutation, NO classes). These compute combat math only; the reducer (a later task) will wire them to GameState.

STYLE RULES: strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No `any`. No classes. No default exports. Never mutate inputs — always return NEW arrays/objects. Export ONLY what is listed. Import types ONLY from '../types' (they exist): `import type { CardDef, WeaponEffect } from '../types';`

File 1: game-core/src/engine/explore.ts
Exports:

1. `export interface ExploreWeapon { readonly damage: number; readonly ammoReq: number; readonly weaponEffects?: readonly WeaponEffect[]; }` — a slim view of a weapon card used in one Explore. Only damage / ammoReq / weaponEffects are read by this module.

2. `export interface DamageParams { readonly weapons: readonly ExploreWeapon[]; readonly ammo: number; readonly bonusDamage: number; }` — weapons used, total Ammo in the player's play area this turn, and per-turn combat bonus (Deadly Aim / character abilities; 0 if none).

3. `export function requiredAmmo(weapons: readonly ExploreWeapon[]): number` — sum of all weapons' ammoReq. Plain reduce; weapons with no ammoReq property yet authored as 0 count as 0 (ammoReq is required in ExploreWeapon, so just sum it).

4. `export function computeDamage(params: DamageParams): number` — total damage for the Explore:
   - start = sum of all weapons' damage + bonusDamage
   - for EACH weapon with a weaponEffect of kind 'plusDamagePerExtraWeapon': if weapons.length > 1, add its amount ONCE (flat, not per weapon) — this is Burst-Fire Handgun's '+20 when attacking with more than one weapon'.
   - for EACH weapon with a weaponEffect of kind 'plusDamageIfAmmoAbove': if params.ammo > threshold (STRICTLY greater), add its amount. (Full-Bore Machine Gun: +30 if ammo > 100. ammo === threshold → NO bonus.)
   - IGNORE the 'grantExplores' weaponEffect kind in damage math entirely (it is a +1 Explore token granted on play, handled by a later task; do not let it affect damage).

5. `export type ExploreOutcome =
     | { readonly kind: 'defeated'; readonly decorations: number }
     | { readonly kind: 'notDefeated'; readonly damageTaken: number; readonly shuffleBack: boolean }
     | { readonly kind: 'nonInfected'; readonly cardId: string }
     | { readonly kind: 'insufficientAmmo'; readonly required: number; readonly available: number };`

6. `export function resolveExplore(params: { readonly weapons: readonly ExploreWeapon[]; readonly ammo: number; readonly bonusDamage: number; readonly revealed: CardDef }): ExploreOutcome` — full combat resolution against ONE revealed Mansion card:
   - if params.ammo < requiredAmmo(params.weapons) → return { kind: 'insufficientAmmo', required: requiredAmmo(params.weapons), available: params.ammo }.
   - const damage = computeDamage(params) (reuse the exported function).
   - if revealed.type !== 'infected' → return { kind: 'nonInfected', cardId: revealed.id } (Item/Token/Yellow Herb: the caller prompts take-or-bottom; no combat math).
   - effective = damage; if revealed has an infectedEffect of kind 'plusDamagePerFull10AmmoOfAttacker', add amount * floor(params.ammo / 10) (Gatling Gun Majini: +5 per full 10 Ammo — 60 ammo → +30).
   - if effective >= (revealed.hp ?? 0) → { kind: 'defeated', decorations: revealed.decorations ?? 0 }.
   - else → { kind: 'notDefeated', damageTaken: revealed.attack ?? 0, shuffleBack: revealed.infectedEffects?.some(e => e.kind === 'shuffleBackIfNotDefeated') ?? false } (Uroboros Aheri: shuffle back into the Mansion deck instead of going to the bottom).

7. `export interface MultiExploreTarget { readonly cardId: string; readonly hp: number; readonly attack: number; readonly infectedEffects?: readonly InfectedEffect[]; }` — NOTE: import InfectedEffect type too. A slim view of revealed Infected cards for the combined rule.

8. `export function resolveMultiExplore(params: { readonly damage: number; readonly revealed: readonly MultiExploreTarget[] }): { readonly defeated: boolean; readonly combinedHp: number; readonly combinedAttack: number; readonly shuffleBackCards: readonly string[] }` — the Extra-Explores combined rule (rulebook ch. IV): when multiple Infected are revealed before comparing, total damage must cover ALL their combined Health:
   - combinedHp = sum of all targets' hp; combinedAttack = sum of all targets' attack.
   - defeated = damage >= combinedHp. (Empty revealed array: combinedHp 0, defeated = damage >= 0 → true — but the reducer should never call it empty; still return the math.)
   - shuffleBackCards = cardIds of every target with an infectedEffect kind 'shuffleBackIfNotDefeated' (only meaningful when NOT defeated — reducer decides; just list them).

File 2: game-core/src/engine/explore.test.ts
Vitest tests. First line must import the helpers: `import { requiredAmmo, computeDamage, resolveExplore, resolveMultiExplore } from './explore';` and `import type { CardDef, MultiExploreTarget, ExploreWeapon } from './explore';` (MultiExploreTarget/ExploreWeapon are exported types — import them so TS narrows correctly). Build CardDef literals inline — do NOT import any card database. Test EXACTLY these cases:

1. requiredAmmo: [{damage:10,ammoReq:20},{damage:20,ammoReq:30}] → 50; [] → 0.
2. computeDamage: two plain weapons [{damage:10,ammoReq:20},{damage:20,ammoReq:30}], ammo 50, bonusDamage 0 → 30.
3. computeDamage: bonusDamage 10, no weapons, ammo 0 → 10.
4. computeDamage Full-Bore: one weapon {damage:40,ammoReq:70,weaponEffects:[{kind:'plusDamageIfAmmoAbove',threshold:100,amount:30}]}, ammo 120 → 70; ammo 100 (NOT > 100) → 40.
5. computeDamage Burst-Fire: weapons [{damage:20,ammoReq:30,weaponEffects:[{kind:'plusDamagePerExtraWeapon',amount:20}]},{damage:10,ammoReq:20}] (length 2), ammo 60 → 30 + 20 = 50; with ONLY the burst-fire weapon (length 1) → 20 (no bonus).
6. computeDamage ignores grantExplores: weapon {damage:25,ammoReq:40,weaponEffects:[{kind:'grantExplores',amount:1}]} → 25.
7. resolveExplore insufficient ammo: weapons [{damage:50,ammoReq:50}], ammo 20 → {kind:'insufficientAmmo', required:50, available:20}.
8. resolveExplore defeated: revealed CardDef {id:'ma-005',name:'Bui Kichwa',type:'infected',set:'premier',text:'',copies:3,hp:10,attack:10,decorations:1}, weapons [{damage:20,ammoReq:10}], ammo 20 → {kind:'defeated', decorations:1}.
9. resolveExplore notDefeated: same revealed as (8) but weapon damage 5 → {kind:'notDefeated', damageTaken:10, shuffleBack:false}.
10. resolveExplore Uroboros shuffleBack: revealed CardDef {id:'ma-010',name:'Uroboros Aheri',type:'infected',set:'premier',text:'',copies:1,hp:90,attack:70,decorations:8,infectedEffects:[{kind:'shuffleBackIfNotDefeated'}]}, weapon damage 50 → {kind:'notDefeated', damageTaken:70, shuffleBack:true}.
11. resolveExplore Gatling Gun Majini: revealed {id:'ma-014',name:'Gatling Gun Majini',type:'infected',set:'premier',text:'',copies:3,hp:40,attack:25,decorations:4,infectedEffects:[{kind:'plusDamagePerFull10AmmoOfAttacker',amount:5}]}, weapon {damage:30,ammoReq:0}, ammo 60 → effective 30 + 5*6 = 60 >= 40 → {kind:'defeated', decorations:4}. With ammo 10 → effective 30 + 5 = 35 < 40 → {kind:'notDefeated', damageTaken:25, shuffleBack:false}.
12. resolveExplore nonInfected: revealed CardDef {id:'it-001',name:'Green Herb',type:'item',set:'premier',text:'',copies:6,cost:20,itemEffects:[{kind:'healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60'}]}, weapons [{damage:10,ammoReq:0}] → {kind:'nonInfected', cardId:'it-001'} (no ammo math applied beyond the required check).
13. resolveMultiExplore all defeated: damage 60, targets [{cardId:'ma-003',hp:15,attack:10,infectedEffects:[{kind:'noActionsNextTurnOfAPlayerOnDefeat'}]},{cardId:'ma-002',hp:20,attack:20}] → {defeated:true, combinedHp:35, combinedAttack:30, shuffleBackCards:[]}.
14. resolveMultiExplore not defeated: damage 40, same two targets → {defeated:false, combinedHp:35, combinedAttack:30, shuffleBackCards:[]}.
15. resolveMultiExplore Uroboros flagged: damage 50, targets [{cardId:'ma-002',hp:20,attack:20},{cardId:'ma-010',hp:90,attack:70,infectedEffects:[{kind:'shuffleBackIfNotDefeated'}]}] → {defeated:false, combinedHp:110, combinedAttack:90, shuffleBackCards:['ma-010']}.

Do NOT weaken, reorder, or add assertions beyond this list. Export types and functions with the EXACT names above. Every expected value above has been verified against the rulebook digest (docs/rules/RULES-DIGEST.md) — trust them.
